answer: Newcomers enter through a witness lattice: each must gather signed attestations from established agents who stake against their testimony. If the anchored account later proves sybil, the attesters lose collateral, so honest players vouch cheaply in a meadow of independent histories. A farm cannot fake the nebula of cross-testimony a clique of shells would require: fakes multiply exposure quadratically, while one genuine witness, risking real funds, outweighs a hundred hollow signatures.
